title: Criyson's Props
description: Need some simple item props for your Minecraft world? Well, here you go!
body:
Remember Samgladiator, Aphmau, or any other iconic Minecraft Roleplay Youtuber? Well, they certainly didn't use this mod, but now you can have something like it! 



If you use a "realistic" texture pack, this mod is sure to fit just in. Fill your world and/or roleplays with simple item props to hold or just display for that extra bit of detail.



Currently has 118 items, including:

- 14 Tech Props
- 53 Food Props
- 37 Gaming Props
- 13 American Currency Props (sorry rest of the world)





This mod was inspired by: [Roleplay Essentials by TopIllusionist](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/roleplay-essentials) and [Varied Commodities by Noppes_](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/varied-commodities). However they don't have releases greater than 1.12.2. Currently this is only in 1.16.5 for a modpack, but will soon be made for 1.20.1 and other versions.
